programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bi

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer Li Ching, the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professors assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leaders illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary Tian Chan Gong and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chans elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qins celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wongs marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wongs close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has posttraumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firms VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of Infernal Affairs are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sams wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gangs conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nations honour.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a super pill invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. Bs superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lians affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witchbut can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a Phantom Bullet that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plants A Garden
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmuller distributes seeds for a class garden project, Olivia just cant wait for her plants to grow. But when her dog Perry digs up her little garden, Olivia discovers something even more exciting what appears to be a dinosaur bone!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Gratitude
programme.desc: When Phoebes Gratitude Day card flies away before she can give it to Marcus, the Dews try to help her recreate it - perfectly. But they learn that you dont have to be perfect to show your gratitude for someone. When Athena finds herself a little short-handed at the Fairhaven Summer Fair, her cousin, Reed, comes to help only to give Athena more problems to fix.

programme.desc: The Community Centers Lost and Found is full and its up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Accidental Hero Rich Kid Ra

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Meow-Mazing Games
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy, and Carlita prepare for the annual Meow-Mazing Games, they encounter stiff competition from the Doodads and must work together to bring home the coveted dollhouse trophy.

When Athena accidentally breaks Lolas nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

Though its hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖 Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, an

programme.title: 正义女神 Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 百味人生 Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 十月初五的月光 Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: 第十二集n华骗娇说要按相士之言安排婚礼程序，众人不虞有诈上华所准备的车信听行家说坚与玲结婚，感诧异，与初赶往教堂娇琳好等被载往关闸，大惊，致电景坚终明白中了华的圈套，为怕琳受伤害，无奈娶玲琳赶往教堂发现坚已与玲成婚，伤心痛哭，坚难过琳回家后反锁自己在房中，好爬气窗入内，安慰她娇明白初不跟自己去美国的苦心，感歉疚，找桃倾诉芳随大马富商才回澳门，多年来历尽冷眼只盼可嫁入豪门初在餐厅遇芳，尾随她至赌场，芳却不知眼前人正是自己亲儿.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 命转皇后 Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: 姜雪宁（白鹿饰）曾费尽心机当上皇后，却在宫变中被逼自杀现在，姜雪宁的梦想就是远离权力，主宰自己的人生可阴差阳错她还是入宫做了伴读，成为帝师谢危（张凌赫饰）的学生，姜雪宁一边接受谢危的教导，一边暗暗筹谋，想要阻止燕临（周峻纬饰）即将面临的血冠礼事件经过姜雪宁和谢危的运筹帷幄，燕家满门性命得保nn血冠礼风波后，姜雪宁无意间卷入了朝廷剿灭平南王乱党的计划，与张遮（王星越饰）一起深入敌营，危急关头姜雪宁以身为张遮挡箭，但二人终是无法相守敌国大月来犯，长公主沈芷衣（刘些宁饰）毅然踏上和亲之路姜雪宁为解救好友沈芷衣随谢危北上讨伐大月，重重危机中谢危为保护姜雪宁甚至不惜伤害自己，二人日渐生情然而更大的阴谋逐渐浮出水面，竟直指二十年前平南王事件的真相最终姜雪宁与谢危连手揭开了当年真相，姜雪宁也用爱感化了谢危，二人终成眷属.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 死有对证 Cause Of Death
programme.desc: 新任女法医程芷昕陈晓华饰从小受林琛韦家雄饰启发，立志加入法医科，入职后却被上司林琛投闲置散林琛与身为重案组高级督察的前妻高淑娴王绮琴饰水火不容，两人因女儿林雪蕾离家出走而再次交集芷昕凭借认真的工作态度赢得林琛认同，并与警员高俊马贯东饰结缘，三人渐成默契十足的办案铁三角芷昕闺密单佩嘉吴若希饰经历失恋失业打击后转任港闻记者，跟资深记者詹柏宇阮浩棕饰从欢喜冤家发展成互相扶持的伙伴正当芷昕事业步入正轨，却闻好友佩嘉死讯，誓要还原真相，为逝者发声！.

programme.title: 剥茧 The Truth Within
programme.desc: 第十二集n翟溪溪生前投保三百万，受益人为患心脏病的弟弟，案情看似自杀骗保；但齐思哲发现她坠楼时被晾衣杆卡住的左鞋竟被换新，证明另有人在场警方以出售1006室设局，抓到私配钥匙的张春民，并锁定保险经纪汪辰汪辰称自己只是救人后换鞋避责，因证据不足获释；同时，翟家药瓶也出现与六芒星相同的神秘标志.

programme.title: 蓝朋友．旅朋友 福州篇 Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: 王祖蓝一条麻甩到东莞汕头之后，延续系列的真实风格再拍摄旅游节目不过，这趟旅途上会多了一些朋友同行，主轴更是要沿着祖蓝生命中的里程坐标，开展连场深度回访，发掘市井生活中的趣味与温情这次取景版图横跨福州广西温哥华，三个极具特色的地方，都在祖蓝不同的人生阶段留下了重大意义祖蓝分别与三组旅朋友走过街巷，从故乡情缘到文化启蒙，再往最重要的爱情归宿，以旅程片段诉说属于王祖蓝独一无二的故事.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.desc: Sembang selebriti merupakan rancangan bual bicara bersama selebriti yang menceritakan tentang pengalaman mereka di dalam dunia seni tanahair yang boleh dijadikan sumber inspirasi. Episod kali ini menampilkan Najmi Niery sebagai selebriti jemputan.

programme.title: TRENDSETTER
programme.desc: Trendsetter bersama Zakuan Zainal menampilkan Swagger Vault dalam segmen Usya Kedai dan Izzat untuk Gaya Kerjaya. Bagi segmen Bedah Kotak, Muhammad Mirzan mengupas secara terperinci perincian keunikan beg mewah Chanel Classic Double Flap.

programme.title: KLTV 2026
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan informasi yang memfokuskan tentang dunia hiburan di Malaysia dari pelancaran music wayang terbaru, isu isu panas terkini dan juga rancangaSiri best untuk dilayan.

programme.title: DAPUR BUJANG
programme.desc: Jom ikuti Chef Naem yang akan berkongsi 2 resipi istimewa yang tersangat mudah, lazat, dan pastinya membangkitkan selera anda! Menu kali ini adalah Keropok Lekor Kepak Ayam Rangup.

programme.title: 1001 RESEPI PERIUK NASI
programme.desc: Saksikan pelbagai cara menyediakan masak kegemaran semua dengan hanya mengunakan Periuk Nasi sahaja. Dalam episod ini Danny Aidil akan menyediakan masakan kegemaran Danny iaitu Kupang Mentega Miso, Pasta makanan Laut Berkrim Ketam Cili bersama Mantao.

programme.title: AROMA MASAK
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Sotong Masak Paprik Bebola Kentang sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Zynakal.

programme.title: INSPIRASI
programme.desc: Inspirasi kali ini bersama Yuna dalam sebuah program temu bual yang menyelami kisah sebenar artis dan figura kreatif. Beliau berkongsi tentang jatuh bangun kehidupan, cabaran, dan kejayaan yang sarat dengan inspirasi, motivasi, serta pengajaran bermakna.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Kemesraan yang dipamerkan oleh Haziq dan Aisyah sebagai pasangan kekasih membuakkan rasa iri hati pada Iskandar. Perubahan itu di kesan apabila Iskandar banyak mempersoalkan tentang layanan yang diberikan pada Haziq tidak pernah dirasainya. Aisyah terasa bahagia dengan apa yang di dengarnya dari mulut Iskandar. Dia tidak pernah menyangka bahawa Iskandar akan menunjukkan rasa cemburu di depannya. Tengku Maria memperkenalkan Tengku Waiduri kepada Aisyah. Saat itu, Aisyah pula terpaksa melihat kemesraan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah, Iskandar sudah memaklumkan hal itu pada Tengku Waiduri, tetapi bukan tentang status mereka sebagai suami isteri tetapi perasaan Iskandar sendiri terhadap Aisyah. Tengku Waiduri yang sudah masak dengan perangai Tengku Maria menyokong penuh tindakan Iskandar agar terus menyembunyikan status mereka sehingga tiba masa yang sesuai. Aisyah memakai gaun yang cantik pada malam itu, mereka makan bersama di rumah Tengku Maria, disebabkan rasa sakit hati melihat kemesraan Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri, Aisyah membawa diri ke ruangan lain dan disebabkan tidak biasa dengan kasut tumit yang tinggi bersama gaun yang labuh, Aisyah tersadung lalu terjatuh di dalam kolam renang di rumah Tengku Maria. Terkejut dengan insiden itu, Iskandar bergegas menyelamatkan Aisyah.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan berasa tenang setelah berkongsi kisah hitam dalam hidupnya hingga meyebabkan dia sukar tidur malam kepada Antasya. Syarfan turut meluahkan bahwa dia menyukai Antasya sejak pertama kali mereka bertemu. Bot datang menyelamatkan mereka. Antasya nekad membawa pulang ayahnya setelah mengetahui keadaan ayahnya dari Najwan. Sejak dari itu Syarfan sering mencari peluang untuk berjumpa Antasya walau seketika. Cinta mereka mula berputik.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Dengan niat hanya sementara, Qasih menerima saje perancangan ibunya untuk pergi Umrah di bawah tunjuk ajar Jazlan semasa di Tanah Suci nanti. Namun kesabaran Jazlan sangat-sangat tercabar dengan kerenah Qasih yang banyak membuang masa dengan berehat dan tidur di bilik dari mengerjakan ibadah di masjid

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam

Imran berasa terperangkap dan tidak berdaya, manakala Laila menemui harapan pada saat yang paling tidak diduga. Sementara itu, satu pendedahan mengejutkan membuatkan Shafiq terpinga-pinga.

programme.title: Dulang Boy
programme.desc: Dulang Boy mengisahkan tentang seorang budak lelaki berusia 10 tahun bernama Kerol Lazania KL yang teruja kerana dipilih menjadi dulang boy untuk majlis perkahwinan kakaknya, Ros. Tugasnya adalah membawa dulang berisi sepasang kasut yang dianggap sangat Istimewa. Namun, pada pagi majlis perkahwinan, KL dan sahabat baiknya Yoyo mencuri masa untuk bergambar dengan kasut tersebut. Malangnya, KL terpijak lumpur lalu mengotorkan kasut tersebut. Mereka cuba mencuci kasut itu, tetapi akhirnya kasut tersebut koyak pula. KL dan Yoyo kemudian berusaha sedaya upaya untuk membetulkan keadaan sebelum majlis bermula.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Meskipun Farah sedang menunggu saat diijabkabulkan, namun dia masih dalam dilema untuk menjadi isteri Lukman. Dia masih keliru dengan keputusannya antara amanah arwah Sarah dengan keikhlasannya menerima abang iparnya sebagai suami. Baik Lukman mahupun Farah, kedua-duanya terpaksa maniskan wajah di majlis pernikahan mereka demi menjaga hati Zahin dan kedua-dua orang tua. Di sebalik kegembiraan, ada hati yang tercarik luka dengan pernikahan mereka. Lantaran terlalu kecewa, Myra sanggup bertindak di luar kawalan hingga menyebabkannya kemalangan dan koma. Joshua muncul untuk membantu Myra lalu membawanya ke hospital. Lukman pula resah kerana tidak dapat menjejak Myra setelah Myra hilang begitu sahaja ketika majlis pernikahannya berlangsung. Farah kecewa apabila Lukman berterus terang yang dia takkan menyentuh Farah kerana dia hanya setia dan cintakan arwah isterinya, Sarah.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah masih terkilan dengan kata-kata Lukman pada malam pertama pernikahan mereka apatah lagi Lukman menyebut nama Myra dalam tidurnya. Farah berasa kurang senang apabila Lukman berpura-pura romantis dengannya di depan famili. Budi terkejut apabila Lukman datang ke pejabat sehari selepas bernikah seakan-akan mahu mengelak daripada Farah. Lukman terkejut setelah menerima surat perletakan jawatan Myra yang ditinggalkan di atas meja. Papa menegur Lukman yang berperangai seperti orang bujang dan balik lewat meskipun sudah berkahwin. Akibat terasa dengan teguran Papa, Lukman bertindak mengajak Farah balik ke rumahnya. Farah cuba menyesuaikan diri dengan keadaan rumah Lukman yang bersepah dan seakan tidak terurus selepas kematian Sarah. Lukman cemburu dan mula syak wasangka apabila melihat Farah bersama Nazim di kafe.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlan membawa Qasih bersiar-siar dan ziarah ke tempat-tempat pelancongan di sekitar Mekah. Di Madinah, Jazlan meneruskan tanggung jawabnya menjadi guide untuk Qasih, membawanya menziarahi tempat-tempat ibadah dan tempat yang bersejarah. Pergaulan Jazlan dan Qasih setakat ini masih tidak menampakkan keserasian antara satu sama lain malah sikap Qasih sangat menguji akan kesabaran Jazlan begitu juga pandangan Qasih terhadap Jazlan

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan berang apabila melihat Datin Jasmin menengkin Antasya. Dia memberitahu ibunya bahawa Antasya mendapat tempat istimewa dia dalam hatinya. Namun Datiin Jasmin tidak mengizinkan mereka untuk bersama malah menelefon Hadi bagi menghapuskan Antasya.Syarfan datang memujuk dan meminta maaf kepada Antasya dan menyatakan hasrat untuk memperisterikan Antasya. Syarfan terkejut apabila melihat profil Antasya dari Datin Jasmin,

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Melihat kejadian Iskandar menyelamatkan Aisyah, Tengku Maria mula bertanya kepada Iskandar adakah dia menyimpan perasaan terhadap Aisyah. Iskandar menafikan sekeras-kerasnya dan menyebabkan Tengku Maria terasa hati apabila Iskandar meninggikan suara. Iskandar tidak mampu melihat kemesraan Aisyah dengan Haziq. Dia merasakan sesuatu yang sangat sakit singgah di dadanya setiap kali Aisyah nampak bahagia dengan orang lain. Di kondo, Aisyah di marahi oleh Iskandar dan menyalahkan Aisyah sengaja membuatnya sakit hati melihat adegan mesra antara Aisyah dan Haziq. Aisyah menafikan hal itu dan dalam masa yang sama Aisyah gembira apabila mendengar luahan Iskandar meskipun dia dimarahi. programme.title: Titi Kayu
programme.desc: Alim, seorang pemuda Cina Peranakan yang disenangi penduduk kampung atas sikap ringan tulang, mengorbankan masa dan tenaga demi membina titi kayu bersama seorang budak bernama Umar, meskipun tidak mendapat sokongan ketua kampung.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Melihat kejadian Iskandar menyelamatkan Aisyah, Tengku Maria mula bertanya kepada Iskandar adakah dia menyimpan perasaan terhadap Aisyah. Iskandar menafikan sekeras-kerasnya dan menyebabkan Tengku Maria terasa hati apabila Iskandar meninggikan suara. Iskandar tidak mampu melihat kemesraan Aisyah dengan Haziq. Dia merasakan sesuatu yang sangat sakit singgah di dadanya setiap kali Aisyah nampak bahagia dengan orang lain. Di kondo, Aisyah di marahi oleh Iskandar dan menyalahkan Aisyah sengaja membuatnya sakit hati melihat adegan mesra antara Aisyah dan Haziq. Aisyah menafikan hal itu dan dalam masa yang sama Aisyah gembira apabila mendengar luahan Iskandar meskipun dia dimarahi. Mak Su Ainin menyokong kuat niat Fasha untuk mencari Aisyah di Kuala Lumpur, namun pada hari Fasha mahu datang ke Kuala Lumpur, rumah Mak Su Ainin telah dimasuki pencuri dan menyebabkan Fasha terpaksa membatalkan niatnya.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah masih terkilan dengan kata-kata Lukman pada malam pertama pernikahan mereka apatah lagi Lukman menyebut nama Myra dalam tidurnya. Farah berasa kurang senang apabila Lukman berpura-pura romantis dengannya di depan famili. Budi terkejut apabila Lukman datang ke pejabat sehari selepas bernikah seakan-akan mahu mengelak daripada Farah. Lukman terkejut setelah menerima surat perletakan jawatan Myra yang ditinggalkan di atas meja. Papa menegur Lukman yang berperangai seperti orang bujang dan balik lewat meskipun sudah berkahwin. Akibat terasa dengan teguran Papa, Lukman bertindak mengajak Farah balik ke rumahnya. Farah cuba menyesuaikan diri dengan keadaan rumah Lukman yang bersepah dan seakan tidak terurus selepas kematian Sarah. Lukman cemburu dan mula syak wasangka apabila melihat Farah bersama Nazim di kafe.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah rasa kepenatan namun dia cuba menyesuaikan diri sebagai isteri dan ibu kepada Zahin. Urusan harian sebagai surirumah agak melelahkan. Namun dia bahagia apabila guru tadika Zahin memberitahu akan perubahan positif Zahin selepas Farah menggantikan tempat arwah Mamanya. Farah mula rasa terkilan dan dalam dilema apabila Liza dan Nazim sudah membuat permohonan untuk melanjutkan pengajian peringkat Master di Universiti Manchester. Joshua pula mula rapat dengan Myra dan mengambil berat akan kebajikan Myra. Dia berpakat dengan Myra untuk mengenakan Lukman setelah mengetahui siapa sebenarnya lelaki yang dibenci Myra itu. Lukman bengang apabila Farah tidak mengambil Zahin di tadika sedangkan Farah kepenatan menguruskan hal ehwal rumahtangga. Farah terkilan kerana Lukman menuduhnya pura-pura sakit dan banyak beralasan. Budi terkejut apabila Myra tiba-tiba muncul di pejabat.

programme.desc: Satu pita rahsia, punca kebimbangan Aisya selama ini berkenaan rahsia masa lalunya yang buruk, telah terbongkar. Betapa gerunnya Aisya apabila menyedari dia menjadi sasaran pembunuh upahan. Sofia bersetuju untuk membantu Black mencari 419 apabila dikatakan kes itu merupakan siasatan tentang ugutan pembunuhan ke atas selebriti kegemaran Sofia, Leo Raja Vokal. Mereka mengesan bunian yang mungkin sedang bersembunyi dalam badan seorang manusia tetapi bunian itu melarikan diri. Black ada sebab yang baik untuk mengawasi Leo kerana bekas pengurusnya merupakan abang ipar 419 yang sudah mati. Black mengesyaki 419 akan membalas dendam terhadap Leo dan apabila itu berlaku, Black bersedia mengheretnya pulang ke dunia bunian. programme.desc: Yeh Kumbang berjumpa dengan Nurin, tiba-tiba Aisha pula hilang dari rumah kerana mengikut Wan Peah ke dalam hutan berhampiran. Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi turut membantu mencarinya tetapi masih gagal. Akhirnya Aisha ditemui ditepi sungai bersama-sama Wan Peah. Farhan dan Cikgu Siti juga keluar mencari Aisha, mereka bersepakat mahu berhadapan dengan Wan Peah kerana mengetahui dia bukan hantu. Cikgu Zaiton membuat fitnah kerana cemburu melihat perhubungan Farhan dengan Cikgu Siti. Akibat tidak berpuas hati, Farhan bersemuka dengan Cikgu Zaiton sehingga berlaku pergaduhan antara mereka.

programme.title: Losmen Melati EP7
programme.desc: Melati, Golok, Sigit dan Ari bersiap sedia untuk melawan Kusno. Sara memasuki losmen mencari Fadil tetapi akhirnya terperangkap di salah satu bilik. Di sana, dia mendapati Fadil terperangkap dalam perigi dari episod 4. Diserang oleh roh rumah, Sara cuba menyelamatkan Fadil dan akhirnya mengorbankan dirinya dalam proses itu. Melati meyakinkan arwah rumah untuk berpihak kepadanya dalam perjuangannya menentang Kusno. Kusno dan Pemburu menyerang Losmen Melati. Sigit berbaik semula dengan Ari atas kengerian masa lalunya dan menentang ayahnya untuk kebaikan. Kini keluar dari perigi, Fadil cuba keluar dari rumah tetapi tersedut untuk melawan Kusno. Berjuang melawan Kusno sendiri, Fadil berada di ambang kematian apabila Kusno menggigitnya, membiarkan kutukan memasuki sistemnya. Apabila semua kelihatan hilang untuk Melati, dia mendedahkan senjata rahsianya - Watih, yang Kusno dipercayai telah mati, kembali untuk memberikan pukulan maut terakhir, akhirnya mengalahkan Kusno sekali dan untuk selama-lamanya. Namun apabila hari baru menjelma, Fadil muncul semula, tetapi semuanya tidak seperti yang disangka. Mata Fadil menjadi hitam, membayangkan kisah Losmen Melati belum berakhir.

Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. programme.title: Happy Old Buddies

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together.

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Former Muay Thai legend Zhong Lei trains pro fighters despite his gyms struggles. When ad executive Lin learns her boyfriend is cheating with a champion boxer, she challenges her rival to a match and undergoes brutal training under Zhong. Through the grueling process, Lins quest for revenge transforms into a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: In a chilly winter, De and his family goes on a self-drive tour to Changbai Mountain. The holiday turns tragic when Des eight-year-old son goes missing. He seeks help from the local police but is unable to find his son. Though the golden hour has passed, De and the rescue team insist on continuing the search. Can they finally rescue the boy?

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmers role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: Dont Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together, and are determined to love each other no matter what happens...

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of a rich mans son bribing prison guards to cover up his criminal activities in the prison to the ICAC. ICAC Chief Officer Luk goes undercover in prison to conduct his investigation. Despite the risks involved, Luk is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Fai Nick Cheung, a legendary triad figure, was convicted and sent to prison for slaughtering a bunch of people. 30 years later, with the help of a social worker Chan Lai Wan, Fai release from prison, the city of Mongkok has totally changed and he has almost forgotten his way back home. Disoriented and trapped in the notorious town of vices, Fai must find his way out of a life with a mother suffering from Alzheimers disease Paw Hee Ching, a hooker girlfriend Mo Xiaoqi with her mentally-challenged younger sister Natalie Meng, and a malicious cop Liu Kai Chi hot on his tail.

programme.title: Mr Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan Gazer Man and Red Aroma Woman, settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback!

programme.title: Peg O My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Chois past?

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away...

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure.

programme.title: My First of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife face devastating trials when their daughter is diagnosed with muscular dystrophy and his mother with cancer. Years later, as the family struggles between holding on and letting go, they find a new connection through a small but powerful sign of hope: the faint movement of their daughters pinky finger.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer Li Ching, the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professors assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Geonly to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leaders illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary Tian Chan Gong and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chans elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

With Yi and Jin tied up in their respective CNY festival performances, Peng and a semi-disguised Everest hit the festive streets, eating and enjoying everything in sight. Meanwhile, while paying respects to her late father at a temple, Yi panics when an accident breaks her magical violin strings. programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City

The crew and creatures band together to try to stop Nian, but theyre no match. Will Yi be able to create magic and connect with the troubled creature without Everests magic strings on her violin?

programme.title: My Life Me

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Overhearing Mr. Towes plan to throw a pop quiz Raffi uses the information to his advantage by studying. programme.title: My Life Me

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her classs International Day. Olivia cant decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country -Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After a trip to the planetarium, Ians knowledge about space and his peculiar behaviour lead Olivia to believe that her brother is an alien. Olivia soon discovers his secrethes making a special gift for his favourite sister
